AS via_label, (v.detail->>'valid_from')::timestamptz AS valid_from, (v.detail->>'valid_to')::timestamptz AS valid_to, v.left_fact AS against_fact, s.canonical_name || ' · ' || COALESCE(r.label, fact_surface_predicate(f.id), '?') || ' · ' || COALESCE(o.canonical_name, '?') AS against_text, v.path AS premises FROM axiom_violations v JOIN facts f ON f.id = v.left_fact JOIN entities s ON s.id = f.subject_id LEFT JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = f.predicate_id LEFT JOIN entities o ON o.id = f.object_id WHERE v.kb_id = #{kbId} AND v.kind = 'derived_contradiction' AND

v.status = 'open'
AND (v.detail->>'subject_id' = #{entityId}::text OR v.detail->>'object_id' = #{entityId}::text) ORDER BY v.detected_at DESC

SELECT d.id, d.predicate_id, d.object_value, d.rule_id, d.attribute_rule_id, d.invalidated_at, d.valid_from_precision, d.valid_to_precision, d.subject_id, s.canonical_name AS subject, d.object_id, COALESCE(o.canonical_name, ct.label, d.object_value ->> 'class', d.object_value #>> '{value}', d.object_value #>> '{}') AS object, r.label AS predicate, COALESCE(ru.kind, 'business') AS rule, ar.name AS rule_name, v.seq AS rule_version, v.definition AS rule_definition, d.valid_from, d.valid_to, d.confidence, d.derived_at, COALESCE( (SELECT array_agg( ps.canonical_name || ' · ' || COALESCE(pr.label, '?') || ' · ' || COALESCE(po.canonical_name, fd.object_value #>> '{value}', fd.object_value #>> '{class}', '?') ORDER BY fd.seq) FROM derivation_premises fd JOIN entities ps ON ps.id = fd.subject_id LEFT JOIN relation_types pr ON pr.id = fd.predicate_id LEFT JOIN entities po ON po.id = fd.object_id WHERE fd.derived_fact_id = d.id), ARRAY[]::text[] ) AS premises FROM derived_facts d JOIN entities s ON s.id = d.subject_id LEFT JOIN entities o ON o.id = d.object_id JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = d.predicate_id LEFT JOIN rules ru ON ru.id = d.rule_id LEFT JOIN attribute_rules ar ON ar.id = d.attribute_rule_id LEFT JOIN attribute_rule_versions v ON v.id = d.attribute_rule_version_id LEFT JOIN entity_types ct ON ct.id = ar.conclude_type_id WHERE d.kb_id = #{kbId} AND d.id = #{id}

SELECT d.id, d.predicate_id, d.object_value, d.rule_id, d.attribute_rule_id, d.invalidated_at, d.valid_from_precision, d.valid_to_precision, d.subject_id, s.canonical_name AS subject, d.object_id, COALESCE(o.canonical_name, ct.label, d.object_value ->> 'class', d.object_value #>> '{value}', d.object_value #>> '{}') AS object, r.label AS predicate, COALESCE(ru.kind, 'business') AS rule, ar.name AS rule_name, v.seq AS rule_version, v.definition AS rule_definition, d.valid_from, d.valid_to, d.confidence, d.derived_at, COALESCE( (SELECT array_agg( ps.canonical_name || ' · ' || COALESCE(pr.label, '?') || ' · ' || COALESCE(po.canonical_name, fd.object_value #>> '{value}', fd.object_value #>> '{class}', '?') ORDER BY fd.seq) FROM derivation_premises fd JOIN entities ps ON ps.id = fd.subject_id LEFT JOIN relation_types pr ON pr.id = fd.predicate_id LEFT JOIN entities po ON po.id = fd.object_id WHERE fd.derived_fact_id = d.id), ARRAY[]::text[] ) AS premises FROM derived_facts d JOIN entities s ON s.id = d.subject_id LEFT JOIN entities o ON o.id = d.object_id JOIN relation_types r ON r.id = d.predicate_id LEFT JOIN rules ru ON ru.id = d.rule_id LEFT JOIN attribute_rules ar ON ar.id = d.attribute_rule_id LEFT JOIN attribute_rule_versions v ON v.id = d.attribute_rule_version_id LEFT JOIN entity_types ct ON ct.id = ar.conclude_type_id WHERE d.kb_id = #{kbId} AND
d.derived_at <= coalesce(#{asOf}, now()) AND (d.invalidated_at IS NULL OR d.invalidated_at > coalesce(#{asOf}, now()))
d.invalidated_at IS NULL
AND (d.subject_id = #{entityId} OR d.object_id = #{entityId}) AND (#{at}::timestamptz IS NULL OR ((d.valid_from IS NULL OR d.valid_from <= #{at}) AND (d.valid_to IS NULL OR d.valid_to > #{at}))) ORDER BY d.derived_at DESC
